#!/bin/bash
set -e -x

# C009: evaluate.py md5 verification
EXPECTED_MD5="17673bf373f00f83ccc41fc1d355a4cd"
ACTUAL_MD5=$(md5sum /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ "$ACTUAL_MD5" != "$EXPECTED_MD5" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: evaluate.py md5 mismatch! Expected $EXPECTED_MD5, got $ACTUAL_MD5"
  exit 1
fi

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python
EVAL=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py
CKPT=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints

run_eval() {
  local name=$1 model=$2 adapter=$3 outdir=$4 bs=$5
  if [ ! -f "$adapter/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    echo "=== SKIP: $name — adapter not found at $adapter ==="
    return
  fi
  # C006: verify lora_alpha=32
  ALPHA=$(grep -o '"lora_alpha": [0-9]*' "$adapter/adapter_config.json" | grep -o '[0-9]*')
  if [ "$ALPHA" != "32" ]; then
    echo "=== SKIP: $name — lora_alpha=$ALPHA (expected 32) ==="
    return
  fi
  mkdir -p "$outdir"
  echo "=== START: $name at $(date) ==="
  $PYTHON $EVAL \
    --model-path "$model" \
    --adapter-path "$adapter" \
    --benchmarks arc_challenge \
    --batch-size "$bs" \
    --output-dir "$outdir"
  echo "=== DONE: $name at $(date), exit=$? ==="
}

# --- 1. Qwen2.5-14B s123 ARC (highest priority) ---
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B
OUT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/results/arc_eval/qwen14b
for d in 000 005 025 050 100; do
  run_eval "qwen14b_d${d}_s123" "$MODEL" "$CKPT/Qwen2.5-14B_d${d}_s123/lora_adapter" "$OUT/d${d}_s123" 4
done
echo "ARC_EVAL_DONE_QWEN14B_S123"

# --- 2. Phi-4 s123 ARC ---
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/phi-4
OUT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/results/arc_eval/phi4
for d in 000 005 025 050 100; do

done
echo "ARC_EVAL_DONE_PHI4_S123"

# --- 3. Qwen2.5-7B s123 ARC ---
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B
OUT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/results/arc_eval/qwen7b
for d in 000 005 025 050 100; do
  run_eval "qwen7b_d${d}_s123" "$MODEL" "$CKPT/Qwen2.5-7B_d${d}_s123/lora_adapter" "$OUT/d${d}_s123" 8
done
echo "ARC_EVAL_DONE_QWEN7B_S123"

# --- 4. OLMo-2 s123 ARC ---
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/OLMo-2-1124-7B
OUT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/results/arc_eval/olmo2
for d in 000 005 025 050 100; do

done

echo "ALL_ARC_EVAL_DONE_S123_BATCH"
